jobs.title: Digital Product Data Analyst
jobs.description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.

Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.

That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.

For our business, for clients, and for you

**Digital Product Data Analyst**

**Description**

The Digital Product Data Analyst is responsible for leveraging data and analytics to drive product performance, user adoption, and business outcomes across digital finance products and platforms. The role partners with Product Owners, Finance, Technology, and Business stakeholders to generate actionable insights, measure product success, and support data-driven decision-making throughout the product lifecycle.

  

**Job specification**

  

**Product Analytics & Insights**

* Analyze product usage, customer behavior, and performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

* Develop KPIs and success metrics to measure product adoption, engagement, and business value.

* Create dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights to product and business stakeholders.

* Monitor product performance and proactively recommend enhancements.

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Collect, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources to support product strategy and decision-making.

* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting environments.

* Produce regular management reporting and ad hoc analysis to support business priorities.

* Translate complex data findings into clear recommendations for non-technical audiences.

**Product & Business Partnership**

* Collaborate with Product Owners to define measurement frameworks for new products, features, and releases.

* Support prioritization decisions through data-driven insights and business case analysis.

* Partner with Finance and Technology teams to evaluate product performance and return on investment.

* Contribute to product roadmaps by identifying user needs and improvement opportunities.

**Data Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Support data governance, quality, and reporting standards.

* Identify opportunities to improve reporting automation and analytical capabilities.

* Promote best practices in data visualization, analytics, and performance measurement.

* Assist in the development of self-service reporting solution

**Skills Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Finance, Economics, Business, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, or related discipline.

* Relevant certifications in Analytics, Data Visualization, Power BI, Tableau, or SQL desirable.

* 3-7 years of experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Business Intelligence, Finance Analytics, or related fields.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with experience working with large datasets.

* Experience supporting digital products, technology platforms, or transformation initiatives.

* Advanced proficiency in Excel and data visualization tools.

* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar reporting platforms.

* Working knowledge of SQL and data analysis techniques.

* Understanding of Agile product development environments preferred.

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  

We pride ourselves in our commitment to fostering a connected and inclusive culture, all our opportunities at Apex have four (4) days in office requirement.

  
  

**What you will get in return:**

* A genuinely unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business;
* Competitive remuneration commensurate with skills and experience;
* undefined **Additional information:** We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made on the basis of skills, qualifications and experiences.We measure our success as a business, not only by delivering great products and services and continually increasing our assets under administration and market share, but also by how we positively impact people, society and the planet.For more information on our commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) please https://www.apexgroup.com/corporate-social-responsibility/

Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
TheData Visualization Analyst will join the Data Insights and Visualization team to contribute to the intersection of business intelligence (BI), telemetry visualization, and modern artificial intelligence. This role will contribute to the development of generative, conversational, and agentic AI capabilities into our existing telemetry platforms and new initiatives. By exploiting the advanced features of our commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) tools alongside custom, home-grown solutions, you will transform raw network data into immediate, actionable insights for our business and operational value teams.
  
  
What will you do in this role
  
  

* Design and deliver end-to-end telemetry analytics and interactive dashboards that combine network flow, metrics, logs, traces, and business context to reduce time-to-insight and time-to-resolution.
* Identify, mine and normalize network data sources (e.g., NetFlow, SNMP, syslog, packet captures, telemetry APIs) and integrate them into real-time pipelines and visualization layers.
* Develop agentic AI agents and AIOps components that continuously analyze streaming telemetry to detect anomalies, and surface proactive recommendations to stakeholders.
* Embed AI-driven insights into visualizations and web applications so executives, product leaders, SREs and network engineers receive role-appropriate, actionable views.
* Build reusable visualization components, templates, and libraries to support routers, switches, firewalls, wireless, SD‑WAN, and core application observability.
* Contribute to telemetry data quality improvement, and performance measurement initiatives for critical network components.
* Professional competencies
* Strong communicator who can translate technical analysis into clear, concise presentations for peers, managers, and executives.
* Passion for building simple, well-designed, and highly usable analytics that deliver measurable value to stakeholders.
* Collaborative team player able to coordinate cross-functional work and deliver on time.

**Primary skills (must-have):**  

* Exposure to large global network infrastructures (routers, switches, LAN, SD‑WAN, firewalls, wireless).
* Exposure to network monitoring, and observability tools such as LogicMonitor, Thousand Eyes, Big Panda, Dynatrace, NetBrain, Grafana Cloud, Zscaler ZDX, or similar.
* Practical experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks, or building conversational interfaces (chatbots) that translate user intent into structured queries (SQL, API calls, or platform-specific query languages).
* 2 years building visualizations and dashboards in BI/observability platforms such as Spotfire, Power BI, Grafana (Cloud/OSS), or equivalent.
* Proven experience building actionable dashboards and role-based views for executives, product owners, and engineers.
* Experience embedding visualizations in web applications and building reusable visualization components.
* Proficiency with one or more general-purpose programming languages and web frameworks: JavaScript (React/Vue), Python (Django/Flask), Java, or similar.

Secondary skills (nice to have)
  
  

* Associate-level developer certifications (AWS, Python, SQL) or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Familiarity integrating agents with ITSM/incident platforms (ServiceNow or similar) and network automation tools (Ansible, or similar).

Who we are
  
  
We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
What we look for
  
  
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are amo…

jobs.title: Agile Product Owner Senior Advisor - HIH - Evernorth
jobs.description:
Agile Product Owner Senior Advisor
  
  
**Position Overview:**  
The Agile Product Owner Senior Advisor is a strategic and collaborative leader within an agile development team, responsible for managing the product backlog and ensuring that development efforts align with customer needs and business goals. This role involves translating high-level business requirements into clear, actionable features, defining acceptance criteria, and prioritizing work to maximize value delivery. The Product Owner serves as the voice of the customer, working closely with developers, architects, operations, and business stakeholders to guide product development through iterative cycles.
  
The Product Owner should embrace the “Product Mindset” and is expected to understand strategic roadmap goals, conduct customer interviews, analyze data, and participate in portfolio discussions to shape the product vision. They are empowered to support intake, prioritize delivery in partnership with business and Engineering, and ensure the Scrum team is focused on solving the right problems with innovative solutions. This role demands strong business and technical acumen, the ability to communicate effectively across teams, and a commitment to delivering measurable outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Understand and align product goals with strategic business objectives to ensure delivery of meaningful value.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with business and technology partners, fostering cross-functional collaboration.
* Act as the primary contact for resolving escalations, removing impediments, and managing stakeholder negotiations and conflicts.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to onboard new initiatives and integrate them effectively into the product development lifecycle.
* Support the development of specifications, including value propositions and technical financial estimates, to guide delivery planning.
* Align with delivery teams to understand capacity and ensure prioritization is accurately reflected in the product backlog.
* Own and refine the product backlog, maintaining a steady flow of well-defined work items for the development team.
* Analyze business needs and support requirement gathering, architecture discussions, and design decisions within agile teams.
* Translate business requirements into actionable features and define iteration scope to guide development.
* Participate actively in agile ceremonies and respond to team inquiries, clarifying features and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate the product vision and strategic decisions to the team, reinforcing customer-centric thinking and business rationale.
* Conduct data analysis and profiling to support product decisions, including mapping source-to-target data and investigating issues using tools like SQL, SAS, or Python

**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 14-16 years of experience in data analysis; Healthcare data domain experience and Agile certification (e.g., SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager) are highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role within Agile development environments, with a strong grasp of Agile principles, Scrum methodology, and modern delivery practices such as continuous integration and test-driven development.
* Proven ability to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable features and acceptance criteria, with a focus on delivering customer-centric solutions.
* Aptitude for gaining deep knowledge of the industry, business strategy, and key data domains (e.g., provider data, claims, membership, benefits), and proactively applying this knowledge to drive meaningful results.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills, with the ability to facilitate collaboration across multiple functions, departments, and levels.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and negotiate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Agile and collaboration tools (JIRA) with hands-on experience supporting agile ceremonies and backlog management.
* Advanced data analysis capabilities, including experience with SQL tools (e.g.,Toad, SAS, Alation), and data profiling techniques; familiarity with cloud technologies and data warehousing is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate code, decode data issues, and support architecture and design decisions.
* Exceptional organizational and work management skills, with experience managing dependencies, risks, and delivery timelines in dynamic, lean/agile environments.

**Required Skills:**  

* Data Analytics Platforms (Databricks and/or Snowflake)
* Python, DevOps, Basic Cloud Experience (AWS/Azure)

**Preferred Skills, Experience Education:**  

* Cloud Certification (AWS Cloud Practitioner or similar)

About Evernorth Health Services
  
Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – Full Stack & Agentic AI
jobs.description:
# Forward Deployed Engineer – Full Stack & Agentic AI

\*\*Location:\*\* Hyderabad, Telangana, India

\*\*Job Type:\*\* Full-time

\*\*Experience:\*\* 5–10 years

\*\*Compensation:\*\* ₹15,00,000–₹30,00,000 per annum

\*\*Work Model:\*\* [On-site]

## About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on \*\*Forward Deployed Engineer\*\* with strong full-stack development experience and a proven background in \*\*Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered product development\*\*.

In this role, you will work closely with customers, product managers, and engineering teams to design, build, deploy, and improve intelligent software solutions. You will translate real-world business requirements into scalable products using modern web technologies, LLMs, AI agents, and cloud platforms.

This is an ideal opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving complex customer problems, working across the technology stack, and rapidly moving AI products from concept to production.

## Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop end-to-end full-stack applications for customer and business use cases.

- Build and deploy \*\*Agentic AI systems\*\*, AI assistants, workflow automation, and multi-step reasoning applications.

- Develop high-performance \*\*RAG pipelines\*\*, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, reranking, and response generation.

- Work with OpenAI APIs, LLMs, function calling, tool use, structured outputs, and prompt engineering.

- Integrate AI agents with internal systems, APIs, databases, SaaS tools, and enterprise workflows.

- Build reliable backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and frontend interfaces.

- Collaborate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions.

- Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on new product ideas and AI capabilities.

- Deploy and operate production systems with appropriate monitoring, logging, security, and performance controls.

- Evaluate model quality, latency, cost, reliability, and user experience.

- Troubleshoot technical issues across application, infrastructure, data, and AI layers.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, engineering standards, documentation, and product strategy.

- Support the full product development lifecycle, from discovery and design through deployment and continuous improvement.

## Required Qualifications

- 5–10 years of professional software engineering experience.

- Strong experience in \*\*full-stack development\*\*.

- Proficiency in one or more backend languages such as \*\*Python, Node.js, Java, Go, or similar\*\*.

- Experience building frontend applications using technologies such as \*\*React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue.js\*\*.

- Strong understanding of REST APIs, microservices, databases, authentication, and cloud deployments.

- Hands-on experience developing applications using \*\*OpenAI APIs or other large language model platforms\*\*.

- Practical experience with \*\*RAG systems\*\*, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval.

- Experience designing or implementing \*\*AI agents, agent workflows, tool calling, or autonomous task execution systems\*\*.

- Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, or similar.

- Experience with Git, CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

- Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

- Ability to work independently in a fast-moving product development environment.

## Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with frameworks and tools such as \*\*LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar agent frameworks\*\*.

- Experience building fast and scalable RAG solutions, including \*\*FastAPI, hybrid search, reranking, caching, and retrieval optimization\*\*.

- Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, Chroma, Elasticsearch, or pgvector.

- Experience with AI evaluation, observability, guardrails, prompt versioning, and model monitoring.

- Experience working directly with customers in a consulting, solutions engineering, startup, or forward-deployed engineering role.

- Experience taking AI products from prototype to production.

- Familiarity with Kubernetes, Terraform, serverless infrastructure, or cloud-native architecture.

- Knowledge of data privacy, security, responsible AI, and enterprise application integration.

- Experience working with product analytics, experimentation, and user feedback.

## What We Offer

- Competitive compensation of \*\*₹15–30 lakhs per annum\*\*, based on experience and technical expertise.

- Medical insurance coverage.

- Provident Fund benefits.

- Opportunity to work on practical, production-grade Agentic AI and RAG applications.

- Direct exposure to customers, product strategy, and end-to-end technology decisions.

- A collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial work environment.

- Opportunities for professional growth and ownership of meaningful projects.

## Ideal Candidate

You are a product-minded engineer who can move comfortably between customer conversations, system architecture, backend development, frontend implementation, and AI experimentation. You enjoy working with ambiguity, delivering quickly, and turning emerging AI capabilities into reliable products that solve real business problems.

## How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with:

- Examples of full-stack or AI products you have built.

- Details of your experience with RAG, OpenAI APIs, or Agentic AI systems.

- Links to GitHub, portfolio, technical articles, or relevant projects, if available.

- Your current location, notice period, and expected compensation.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹3,000,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

**Job Title** : **UX Designer**

**Location :Hyderabad ,Hybrid(3days on-site & 2days remote)**

**Fulltime**

**Job Description**

**Summary/objective**

isolved builds Human Capital Management software that millions of people use to get paid, manage time off, enroll in benefits, and run HR for their companies. The work touches essential parts of people's lives, so the experience needs to be clear, efficient, and trustworthy. You'll drive evidence-based product decisions for the isolved platform, working alongside engineers and product managers as the designer for the experiences you're assigned. You plan the research, shape the direction, and carry the work from problem framing through to what ships, using design thinking methods to ground decisions in how people actually behave rather than how we assume they do.The isolved platform is broad and interconnected. The designers who do well here can design a feature and also see how it ripples through the rest of the product: what it touches, what it changes, and what has to stay consistent.

**Core Job Duties**

* End-to-end experience design: discovery, flows, wireframes, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, and handoff
* Choose the right research method for the question at hand, run it, and turn raw findings into insights the team can act on. Synthesis and storytelling matter as much as the research itself
* Bring product and engineering into the research as it happens so decisions are shared, not pitched after the fact
* Design with the isolved design system and build on it, contributing new components and patterns when your work exposes a gap
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders, with clear goals and tangible outcomes
* Present work to the design team and stakeholders, give and take critique well, and iterate quickly
* Use AI tools as part of your everyday workflow: research planning, synthesis, competitive analysis, exploration, and documentation
* Design for accessibility and for the range of devices and contexts our users work in

**Job Complexity**

Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex data platform issues creatively and effectively. Serves as the hands-on, go-to expert for isolved's data platform infrastructure, administration, and pipeline operations. Some barriers to entry exist at this level (e.g., peer or architecture review).

Interaction

Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside their own area of expertise.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 6+ years designing software products, ideally complex, data-heavy business applications
* A portfolio that shows how you think, not just what you shipped: the problem, the constraints, what you tried, and why the final answer won
* A clear research-to-design methodology. You can explain why you picked qualitative over quantitative (or the reverse) on a real project, and how research showed up across the whole process, not only in discovery
* Experience working within an established design system and contributing back to it, and the judgment to know when to extend it versus follow it
* A habit of looking for the root problem. The request you receive is often a symptom
* Comfort with the full UX toolkit: research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping
* Fluency with AI as a working tool. You already use it across your design process: planning and synthesizing research, exploring directions, prototyping, writing, and pressure-testing your own thinking. You can explain where it made your work better and where you overrode it
* Direct, concise communication with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience using AI to build or maintain design system assets, or designing AI-driven product experiences
* Enough working knowledge of front-end concepts to have a good conversation with an engineer about how something gets built
* Experience in HCM, payroll, benefits, or another regulated, workflow-heavy domain
* Experience modernizing a legacy product while it stays in production

Job Description
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.

* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.

* 6 years architecting enterprise-scale network monitoring or observability architectures, integrating network telemetry platforms with IT Service Management (ServiceNow API) and incident correlation engines.
* 6 years building observability and data normalization across complex telemetry types (logs, metrics, traces, flows) and proactive alerting/AIOps integration.
* 8 years developing complex multi-source data pipelines using data engineering tools such as Dataiku, Databricks.
* Proven experience building actionable dashboards and role-based views for executives, product owners, and engineers.
* Experience embedding visualizations in web applications and building reusable visualization components.
* Proficiency with one or more general-purpose programming languages and web frameworks: JavaScript (React/Vue), Python (Django/Flask), Java, or similar.
* 4-year college degree majoring in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Business Intelligence, or similar.

Secondary skills (nice to have)
  
  

* Engineer or specialist level developer certifications (AWS, Python, SQL) or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Familiarity integrating agents with ITSM/incident platforms (ServiceNow or similar) and network automation tools (Ansible, or similar).

T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS), headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is America’s supercharged Un-carrier, connecting millions through its strong nationwide network and flagship brands, T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile. **TMUS Global Solutions:**

TMUS Global Solutions
is a world-class technology powerhouse accelerating the company’s global digital transformation. With a culture built on growth, inclusivity, and global collaboration, the teams here drive innovation at scale, powered by bold thinking.

**About the Role:**

The Senior Product Owner is accountable for backlog strategy, prioritization, and requirements definition for T-Mobile’s offshore AI Platform & Reliability Engineering organization. This role owns what gets built and in what order across AI platform capabilities, agent systems, platform engineering initiatives, reliability improvements, technical debt reduction, and operational excellence investments. The role ensures engineering investments remain aligned with business priorities while balancing feature delivery, platform sustainability, operational excellence, and technical debt reduction.

The Senior Product Owner serves as the product-side decision-maker for backlog prioritization, partnering closely with the Manager, Software Engineering - AI Platform & Reliability Engineering, who owns delivery execution, engineering operations, people leadership, and production reliability. The role reports to the Manager with a dotted-line relationship to onshore Product Management to ensure alignment with strategic product direction.

Success is measured through prioritization quality, roadmap alignment, backlog readiness, reduction of engineering rework, stakeholder alignment, and the team’s ability to consistently execute against business and platform objectives. We pride ourselves on encouraging a culture of innovation, agile ways of working, and transparency in all we do. Join us in embodying the spirit of the Un-carrier and making a tangible impact.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own backlog strategy, prioritization, and sequencing across AI platform capabilities, platform engineering initiatives, reliability improvements, technical debt, and operational excellence investments.
* Translate product strategy and roadmap objectives into well-defined epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are ready for engineering execution.
* Partner with engineering managers, architects, and technical leads to ensure backlog priorities align with platform architecture, engineering capacity, and business objectives.
* Balance competing priorities across feature delivery, platform sustainability, scalability, reliability, and technical debt while clearly communicating tradeoffs.
* Prioritize AI platform capabilities including agent orchestration, conversational platforms, SDKs, enterprise integrations, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-enabled capabilities.
* Ensure production readiness, operational excellence, and reliability engineering initiatives are appropriately represented within backlog priorities.
* Collaborate with onshore Product Management to align offshore engineering execution with product strategy and roadmap objectives.
* Coordinate dependencies across engineering teams, architects, Product Owners, and platform stakeholders to improve delivery predictability.
* Accept completed work against defined business and technical acceptance criteria.
* Use engineering metrics, operational insights, customer feedback, and platform health indicators to continuously refine backlog priorities and roadmap sequencing.

**What You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Owner, Product Management, Technical Program Management, Engineering, or related roles.
* Demonstrated experience owning prioritization decisions for complex engineering organizations supporting multiple workstreams and competing business priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in technically complex environments involving distributed systems, cloud-native platforms, AI-powered services, platform engineering, or reliability engineering.
* Proven experience managing backlogs that include feature delivery, platform investments, technical debt reduction, and reliability engineering work.

**About Us**
DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.
  
  
There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!
  
  
**About The Role**
This is the first product role DriveWealth has placed in-market, and you will own what it becomes. You are the product voice for our partners in India across the full platform: equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options, plus the account opening and money movement capabilities underneath them. Partners in this market bring requirements that are specific, sometimes ambiguous, and always urgent, and your job is to convert them into scoped, sequenced, shipped work. You will not run a dedicated engineering team. Your leverage comes from judgment, credibility, and your ability to pull the right product owners and engineering leads across the platform onto the right problem. You own the call on which requests become roadmap, which get an alternative solution, and which get a clear no. You will work in close partnership with our regional Head of Sales, and you will represent this function directly to partners and to product leadership. Success in year one looks like partners in India who feel heard, a delivery record they can point to, and a repeatable model we can stand up in the next jurisdiction.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Become the primary product point of contact for our partners in India, and build the relationships that surface real requirements before they become escalations

* Spot the patterns across requests that point to a platform gap, and drive them into the appropriate domain roadmap yourself
* Decide when to push back, when to escalate, and when to absorb complexity to keep delivery moving, without needing that judgment checked
* Speak for this function in partner, sales, and product leadership forums on status, tradeoffs, and constraints
* Write the playbook for in-market product delivery, with an eye to what should scale to the next jurisdiction

* Minimum 7 years of experience in Financial Services and/or Fintech or equivalent industries, in product management, business analysis, or a senior partner-facing technical role
* Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent in relevant experience
* Experience with trading platforms, brokerage, or fintech infrastructure
* Experience analyzing data using SQL and relevant BI tools
* FINRA Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) completion, or a commitment to acquire within the first year with support from your Manager
* A track record of ownership and disciplined execution in high-stakes environments
* The ability to prioritize ruthlessly, focussing on what’s critical versus important to drive work to completion
* A client-oriented mindset with an understanding of how your work impacts partners
* Strength in cross-functional partnership with the judgment to coordinate across multiple teams
* A bias toward transparency, accountability, and responsiveness in everything you do
* You’re committed to continuous improvement and implicitly believe that we > I.
* Impeccable high integrity, sound judgment, and a deep respect for risk, control, and operational excellence

**Location**
This role is open to candidates in the following locations:

* This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
* If you're not based in one of the location listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside this location.

Opportunities for salary increases based on performance, contribution, and company growth

**Working Hours:**
1:00 PM–11:00 PM IST, including allocated breaks

**Joining:**
Immediate joiners or candidates available within one week preferred

**About the Role**

Zexovo is looking for a Product Manager to help build and grow
**HotelOS**
, our AI-powered hotel management platform.

We need someone who understands hotel operations and how property management, revenue management, channel management, direct bookings, guest services, and payments work together.

You will work closely with the founding team, designers, engineers, and QA to translate hotel requirements into clear workflows and reliable product releases.

**During the initial stage, you will also participate in prospective customer conversations, product demonstrations, and follow-ups, working with the sales team to help convert interested hotels into customers.**
You should be comfortable explaining product capabilities, understanding objections, and bringing customer feedback into product decisions.

**Product Areas You Will Work Across**

* **Property Management System:**
  Reservations, room allocation, check-in and checkout, guest profiles, billing, group bookings, and housekeeping.
* **Revenue Management System:**
  Pricing recommendations, demand forecasting, competitor rates, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and pricing controls.
* **Channel Manager:**
  OTA connectivity, room and rate-plan mapping, availability and rate synchronization, restrictions, booking modifications, and cancellations.
* **Booking Engine:**
  Direct reservations, offers, booking policies, deposits, and payment confirmation.
* **Guest Portal:**
  Online check-in, communication, service requests, upsells, and payments.
* **Embedded Payments:**
  Physical payment terminals, online payments, preauthorization holds, captures, refunds, transaction tracking, and reconciliation.
* **AI Automation:**
  Automated hotel workflows with clear permissions, approval controls, and exception handling.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather requirements from hotel owners, front-desk teams, revenue managers, and operational staff.
* Map complete guest and staff journeys across HotelOS and identify dependencies between modules.
* Write product requirements, functional specifications, user stories, workflow diagrams, and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritize features, improvements, and defects based on customer impact, business needs, and engineering effort.
* Collaborate with designers and engineers to deliver intuitive web and mobile experiences.
* Coordinate integrations with OTAs, channel connectivity partners, payment providers, and other hotel systems.
* Define workflows for booking changes, cancellations, overbooking, failed payments, refunds, and synchronization failures.
* Research competing hospitality products and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Define AI use cases, expected outcomes, approval requirements, and fallback processes.
* Work with QA on test scenarios and user acceptance testing.
* Support hotel onboarding, product training, release documentation, and customer feedback collection.
* Join sales calls and lead product demonstrations during the initial growth stage.
* Help prospective customers understand how HotelOS fits their operations, address product questions, and support conversion alongside the sales team.
* Track product adoption, customer feedback, and recurring issues to guide improvements.

**Required Qualifications**

* **At least 2 years of relevant product management experience in hospitality software.**
* Hands-on experience with a hotel PMS and practical understanding of RMS, channel managers, booking engines, guest portals, and hotel payments.
* Strong understanding of daily hotel operations and how information flows between these systems.
* Experience taking software features from requirements gathering through development, testing, and release.
* Ability to independently create clear requirements, workflow diagrams, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience collaborating with engineering, design, and QA teams.
* Strong communication skills and confidence speaking with hotel owners, managers, and prospective customers.
* Willingness to support customer conversations, demonstrations, and conversions during the company’s initial growth stage.
* Familiarity with Jira, ClickUp, Notion, Google Docs, Figma, Miro, or similar tools.
* Availability for the stated full-time working hours.

**Prior hospitality software experience is essential. Please clearly identify the products and modules you have worked on and your individual contributions.**

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with payment integrations and physical card terminals.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, synchronization, and error handling.
* Experience with AI-powered products or workflow automation.
* Experience onboarding hotels, migrating data, or supporting multi-property operations.
* Experience delivering product demonstrations or supporting SaaS sales conversions.

**Compensation and Growth**

The initial salary for this position is
**₹18,000–₹20,000 per month**
. As Zexovo grows, there will be opportunities for salary increases based on individual performance, responsibilities, contribution to product and customer growth, and the company’s financial position.

This role offers direct collaboration with the founding team and the opportunity to take on greater product ownership as HotelOS expands.

* Provides leadership and vision on IC product roadmap and requirements.
* Continuously improves our portfolio offering, balancing business needs with R&D efficiency.
* Creates product roadmaps based on various segment inputs to meet the requirements for a diverse range of applications

This is one of the few functions where you will have the great opportunity to discuss with top executives regarding strategy and execution on a day-to-day basis, thus having invaluable amount of learning.

Come and join us in our goal to become the undisputed leader in wireless connectivity for IoT!

**Responsibilities**

* Define SoC product requirements, features, specifications, and system KPIs for core CPU, co-processors, accelerators, power management, digital and analog peripherals, security sub-system, radio sub-system, and packages.
* Map market systems application requirements to product use cases, including system block diagrams, compute and peripheral requirements, and protocol stack features and performance requirements for Wi-Fi, Matter, Thread, ZigBee, Bluetooth Low Energy, Bluetooth Classic, Sidewalk, Wi-SUN, and proprietary protocols.
* Define hardware and evaluation tools for customers, including debug interfaces such as JTAG, SWD, ETM trace, PTI, virtual communication port requirements, and user interfaces such as push buttons, LCDs, LEDs, analog joysticks, and RHT sensors.
* Collaborate with leaders and individual contributors across functional teams such as IC design, product test, software development, product and segment marketing, applications, operations, and sales to develop long-term innovation ideas, roadmap, and silicon definition.
* Drive the product development process from concept through definition and pitch the most promising product ideas to executive staff.
* Conduct key competitive analysis, including tear-down at the die level and various spec analyses, to provide conclusive takeaways for design, specification, and fighting guides.
* Manage the entire portfolio of scalable products with clear mapping to target applications.

**Skills You Will Need**

*Minimum Qualifications*

* BSEE/BSCS (or equivalent) and 10+ years of experience in semiconductor product management or IoT industry
* Core development experience in IC front end / architecture / verification / embedded systems
* Knowledge of key architectural considerations for PPA, including power estimation, die size estimation, and fundamental process node technology principles.
* Knowledge of Wireless Modem and RF Design principles for any of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, 802.15.4, and other Low Power Wireless standards
* Proven ability to work successfully at a technical level with cross-functional engineering teams, including hardware and software engineers
* Experience developing business cases for Technology investments working with Business Unit partners, sensitivity analysis of business case to variables under consideration.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, especially to executive management

*The following qualifications will be considered a plus:*

* Development experience in either wireless or wired communication protocols
* MBA or equivalent business graduation

Benefits & Perks

Not only will you be joining a highly skilled and tight-knit team where every engineer makes a significant impact on the product; we also strive for good work/life balance and to make our environment welcoming and fun.

· Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

· Insurance plans with Outpatient cover

jobs.title: Business Analyst – Data In-Licensing & Data Governance
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Business Analyst**
– Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Role: Business Analyst – Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Domain: Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical R&D Engagement Focus: Current-State Assessment, Gap Analysis, Requirements Definition & Future State Roadmap Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with strong knowledge of data governance, data licensing, data lifecycle management, and enterprise data management practices to support an assessment of the Data In-Licensing process within Novartis Biomedical Research (NIBR). The individual will work closely with business, scientific research, data management, legal, procurement, compliance, and technology stakeholders to assess the current operating model, identify process and technology gaps, and recommend improvements to strengthen governance, compliance, traceability, and operational efficiency across the licensed data lifecycle. Key
**Responsibilities**

1. Data In-Licensing Process Assessment Analyze the end-to-end data in-licensing lifecycle, from data acquisition and contractual agreements through onboarding, provisioning, consumption, renewal, expiry, and retirement. Conduct stakeholder interviews and workshops to understand the current operating model, systems, responsibilities, and pain points. Identify manual activities, fragmented workflows, unclear ownership, and opportunities for automation. Prepare AS-IS process maps, gap assessments, and recommended TO-BE workflows.

2. Data Bill of Materials (DBoM) and License Management Define business requirements for a centralized Data Bill of Materials to track all licensed datasets. Identify essential metadata, including data provider, dataset ownership, licensing terms, permitted usage, restrictions, contractual obligations, renewal dates, expiration timelines, and retention requirements. Assess current mechanisms for tracking licensed datasets and their downstream dependencies. Define requirements for notifications, license renewals, compliance checkpoints, and expiry management.

3. Access Governance and Entitlement Management Assess existing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and entitlement management processes. Map user roles, access privileges, approval workflows, and data usage restrictions to contractual requirements. Identify gaps in access approvals, access reviews, and entitlement revocation. Define business requirements for visibility into who accesses licensed datasets, for what purpose, and under which permissions.

4. Data Lifecycle and Retention Management Evaluate existing practices for data retention, archival, expiration, and secure deletion. Translate contractual retention and deletion obligations into actionable business requirements. Identify gaps in handling expired licenses, downstream copies, and derived datasets. Define requirements for deletion workflows, approvals, exception handling, and evidence of deletion.

5. Auditability, Data Lineage, and Compliance Assess the organization's ability to trace licensed data from acquisition to consumption. Define requirements for audit trails, usage monitoring, and end-to-end data lineage. Identify gaps in demonstrating compliance with contractual usage restrictions and internal governance policies. Work with risk, legal, and compliance stakeholders to define reporting and audit evidence requirements.

6. Gap Analysis and Future-State Recommendations Consolidate findings into a structured gap assessment covering people, process, technology, and governance. Prioritize gaps based on business impact, contractual exposure, operational risk, and implementation complexity. Develop business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and a prioritized improvement backlog. Collaborate with the Data Engineer and solution architects to define feasible remediation options and a phased implementation roadmap.

**Required Skills and Experience**

• 6–10 years of Business Analysis experience, preferably in pharmaceutical, life sciences, research data, or regulated enterprise environments.

• Experience with data governance, data management, data cataloging, and metadata management.

• Understanding of data licensing, contractual data usage restrictions, and third-party data management.

• Strong knowledge of RBAC, access governance, data lifecycle management, and audit requirements.

• Experience with business process mapping, stakeholder workshops, gap assessments, and requirements documentation.

• Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, data lineage concepts, and enterprise data architectures.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

• Exposure to pharmaceutical R&D or scientific research data ecosystems.

• Experience with data governance/catalog platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Alation, or equivalent.

• Understanding of GDPR, retention policies, contractual compliance, and internal data governance standards.

• Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Visio, or BPMN modeling tools.

**Expected Deliverables**

• Current-State Data In-Licensing Process Assessment.

• Stakeholder and System Interaction Mapping.

• End-to-End Process and Governance Gap Analysis.

• DBoM Business Requirements and Metadata Definition.

• Access Control, Entitlement, Retention, and Deletion Requirements.

• Auditability and Data Traceability Requirements.

• Future-State Process Recommendations.

• Prioritized Business Requirements and Remediation Roadmap. Primary Outcome: A comprehensive understanding of business and governance gaps, with actionable recommendations to establish an efficient, compliant, and traceable data in-licensing process.

jobs.title: Business Analyst Lead
jobs.description:
The Business Process Improvement Analyst sits within the Enterprise Transformation Office. This role works under the direction of the Director of Process Transformation to engage with Service Lines or other functions across the business to diagnose root causes of pain points, understand and map current-state processes, define performance metrics and translate findings into actionable improvement recommendations including; process redesign, automation AI-enabled solutions, and draft relevant requirements.

Engagements span the full range from targeted improvements within a single business team to larger, enterprise-wide initiatives. The analyst can engage across the firm, including Tax, Assurance, Advisory and Outsourced Services Service Lines, as well as other operational teams, wherever process improvement work is needed.

At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether youre starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career youll love from top to bottom we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.

  

**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top Places to Work awards
* We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create innovative solutions
* We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
* Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support ETO business analysts & engage as directed with business unit stakeholders to identify pain points, inefficiencies and improvement opportunities through interviews, workshops, and process observation.
* Map & analyze current-state ("as-is") processes using ETO standard notation (swim lanes, SIPOC, value stream) and validate with process owners.
* Document data flows and system touchpoints as part of process mapping, particularly where they inform automation, integration, or AI-enabled recommendations.
* Design and support the implementation of process performance metrics and KPIs (leading and lagging indicators) to baseline performance and track the impact of improvements.
* Develop future-state ("to-be") process recommendations, including process redesign, automation, and AI/technology-enabled solutions.
* Translate discovery sessions and stakeholder input into structured requirements, process documentation, and decision-ready materials for the Director and business sponsors.
* Understand whats needed to develop credible business cases for recommended changes, including effort, cost, and expected benefits, and work to gather relevant data/information as part of the initiative documentation.
* Contribute reusable process artifacts (templates, capability maps, documentation standards) to the Process Center of Excellence to promote consistency across projects and across the firm.
* Act as a bridge between business and technology teams by clearly articulating business requirements and validating that proposed solutions address the root problem.
* Track and report on the status of improvement initiatives, flagging risks and dependencies to the Director.
* Promote a continuous improvement mindset within partner business units.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Process maps and requirements are accurate, validated by stakeholders, and reused without rework.
* KPIs/metrics are in place and actively tracked within [6090] days of engagement start.
* Improvement recommendations are adopted by business sponsors and show measurable impact against baseline.
* Documentation meets Process COE standards and is contributed back to the shared library.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Information Systems, or related field.
* 6-10 years of experience in business process analysis, operations, consulting, or transformation roles, with demonstrated ownership of process work (not just support/documentation).
* Proven ability in writing business, data, & technical requirements and the development of wireframes to clearly articulate solutions
* Proven proficiency in process mapping (current- and future-state) - able to independently run mapping sessions and produce validated, accurate artifacts with minimal oversight.
* Confident engaging business unit stakeholders directly - able to ask the right questions, surface real pain points, and read between the lines of what's said versus what's actually broken.
* Demonstrated ability to recognize and shape improvement opportunities - not just document "as-is" state, but connect root causes to practical recommendations (process, tech, automation, or AI).
* Experience defining and standing up KPIs/metrics; familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma, BPMN, or similar frameworks preferred.
* Strong analytical skills - comfortable working with process and operational data to identify root causes and quantify impact.
* Ability to manage time across multiple projects and escalate when help is required.
* Working knowledge of process/workflow tools (e.g., Visio, Miro) and data/reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Domain focus: Design Assurance practice delivery across all Cyber Architecture and Solutions security domains.**

**Job Purpose:**

  

The delivery management layer in the Design Assurance practice, between the Principals and the analysts. You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against demand, track findings to closure across the practice, and manage the assurance throughput and turnaround metrics the function is judged on. You carry a review caseload alongside the management load.

**About the team:**

Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles.

You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against incoming demand, drive findings to closure across every domain, and run the governance reporting and audit evidence packs. This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

* Verify against standards the practice does not write, and protect that separation in how work is allocated.
* Spot capacity pressure in the pipeline two sprints out and escalate it, rather than letting turnaround slip quietly and explaining it afterwards.
* Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

* Managing delivery across Principals and analysts — review scheduling and reviewer allocation against demand, using workflow automation
* Tracking findings to closure with throughput and turnaround metrics, and running practice governance reporting and audit evidence packs

jobs.title: Senior Principal - Design Assurance & Product Management - Portfolio-wide Analytics
jobs.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Domain focus: Portfolio-wide analytics supporting all domain product owners.**

**Job Purpose:**

Own portfolio intelligence and investment analytics for Cyber Architecture and Solutions. You turn portfolio, vendor and delivery data into the evidence prioritisation and investment decisions are made from, and you are the analytical backbone of the function.

**About the team:**

Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles.

**What makes this role different. A genuinely analytical role, not a reporting role, and the distinction matters. Producing the pack is the easy part; the value is spotting the trend nobody asked about and bringing it to leadership unprompted. You do not need to have built security controls, but you do need to read a MITRE ATT&CK coverage map and judge for yourself whether two tools genuinely overlap or only appear to in the licence schedule. Your numbers will be used in investment decisions and challenged by people who do not want the answer, so they have to reconcile and you have to defend them.**

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Own portfolio intelligence across the Cyber Architecture and Solutions product and project estate.
* Build and maintain the investment analytics that prioritisation decisions are made from.
* Produce portfolio reporting the leadership team steers by, and make the numbers defensible under challenge.
* Analyse vendor spend, performance and value across the managed service, including the OTO transition.
* Model investment scenarios and quantify trade-offs between competing priorities.
* Track benefit realisation against the cases that funded the work, including where benefits did not materialise.
* Own the data and definitions behind the reporting so figures reconcile across every forum.
* Identify trends and outliers and bring them to leadership attention unprompted.
* Build the costed option set for the annual plan, sequencing investment and decommission against the renewal calendar so consolidation savings are realised in the year they are claimed.
* Set the analytical standard for the function — data lineage, definition control and reproducibility — so any figure in a leadership pack can be traced to source and re-derived by someone else.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
* Apply data integrity and GxP record-keeping expectations to the figures this role publishes, so portfolio and benefit reporting stands up to audit.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 15+ years in cyber security or technology portfolio analytics in a regulated environment — domain focus: portfolio-wide analytics supporting all domain product owners
* Building a security portfolio intelligence capability at enterprise scale — threat-to-tool coverage matrix showing weak, duplicated or missing coverage, investment gaps and decommission candidates
* Automated portfolio monitoring — integrating tool inventory, licence and consumption, contract and renewal, cost and risk data into continuously refreshed dashboards, reconciling incomplete CMDB data
* Evidence-based decommission and consolidation business cases with quantified savings or risk reduction, analysed on the same domain structure as Security Solution Engineering
* Applying AI and machine learning to portfolio analytics — anomaly detection on licence and cost data, AI-assisted coverage mapping and assessment of AI-enabled security tools

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Power BI or equivalent, SQL and Python for portfolio analytics, automation and data engineering
* Security tool landscape knowledge across all security product domains, enough to judge whether two tools genuinely overlap
* MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF applied to coverage mapping rather than cited in isolation
* Total cost of ownership, licence utilisation and shelf-ware analysis, including unused entitlement ahead of renewal

* Investment modelling and analytics support for domain product managers' portfolio decisions
* Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typical tools and technologies: Power BI or equivalent, SQL and Python for analytics and automation, data modelling across tool inventory, licence entitlement and consumption, contract and renewal dates …

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Gushwork is building an Agent Operating System for small and mid-sized businesses around the world. It is modern business software where AI agents and humans work together. Business owners and leaders set the goals. They decide what each agent is allowed to do. Then they review the metric each agent delivers.  
  
We started with an SEO agent. It owns one metric: organic leads. Once it ranks pages and brings in leads, it reports them back to the customer. We are now expanding into a Paid Ads agent and a Developer agent, each owning a metric the business cares about.  
  
Our customers sell high-value goods and services and have fewer than 200 employees. Most of them are in industries that are not digitally native: manufacturers, industrial distributors, commercial services. They do not buy AI. They buy outcomes. Our job is to make agents reliable enough that a business owner can trust them with a number.  
  
We are a team of about 90 people based in Bengaluru, backed by Lightspeed and SIG. If you want to want to help us build reliable agents that runs real businesses, we're excited to meet you!

### **About the role:**

Our customers use paid advertising to generate leads and grow their businesses. The Performance Marketing Specialist owns the execution and continuous improvement of these campaigns across Meta and Google.

You will work directly with customers to understand their business, translate their objectives into campaign strategies, take campaigns live and continuously improve performance.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role. You are expected to understand the numbers, make decisions, identify opportunities and execute experiments. The focus is on improving campaign outcomes, not simply managing campaigns or reporting performance.

### **What you'll do:**

* Own customer campaigns end to end, from understanding requirements and setting up accounts to launching and managing campaigns.
* Understand each customer's business, industry, target audience and objectives to develop relevant campaign strategies.
* Manage and optimize campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads, including budgets, targeting, bidding, audiences and campaign structures.
* Continuously monitor campaign performance, identify opportunities and implement optimisations to improve metrics such as CPL, CPA, conversion rates and lead quality.
* Ideate and execute experiments across creatives, messaging, ad formats, audiences, targeting and campaign strategies.
* Explore different creative approaches and formats, including Reels, videos and variations in messaging, to improve campaign performance.
* Communicate directly with customers, understand their feedback, explain campaign performance and align on optimisation plans.
* Take ownership of campaign outcomes and proactively identify issues and opportunities rather than waiting for instructions.

### **What you have:**

### **Must-haves**

* Hands-on experience running and managing campaigns on both Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Experience independently setting up, launching, monitoring and optimising campaigns.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate campaign data into actionable decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly in customer-facing situations.
* Strong account and stakeholder management skills.
* High ownership, bias towards execution and the ability to independently drive things to completion.
* Ability to understand different industries and customer behaviours and adapt campaign strategies accordingly. There is no single optimisation playbook that works for every business.
  

### **Good to have**

* Minimum 2 years of genuine hands-on performance marketing experience.
* Experience running lead-generation campaigns.
* Experience with creative strategy and performance-driven ad experimentation.
* Prior experience in a digital marketing agency or managing multiple customer accounts.
* Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads Manager, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and conversion tracking.

### **Why you'll love us:**

* You'll be part of an early team at a fast-growing company, with a lot of impact
* You'll get to work with really smart and helpful people
* We constantly adopt the latest technologies and stay close to the latest ai innovations
* Opportunity to influence the direction of the product and engineering culture
* Flexible PTO policy
* Unlimited ai usage
* Plus cool swag, a stocked pantry, and other benefits

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Job Description Great data only matters if it arrives. Gracenote's delivery platform moves millions of pieces of TV entertainment data every day into the backend systems of the world's leading cable, OTT, CE, and digital companies, powering entertainment experiences used by hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Director of Product Management to own this platform from our Bengaluru product and engineering center. You will set the product vision and roadmap for our Unified Data Delivery Platform, the centralized repository that consolidates diverse data from across Gracenote into a single Source of Truth, and for the full family of Video metadata delivery solutions that carry that data to clients worldwide. You will lead a team of two product managers in India and partner daily with our engineering teams to deliver against that roadmap.

Delivery is its own discipline. It is where Gracenote's data meets client systems, with all of the schema, integration, scale, and reliability challenges that implies. It is also the tip of the spear. When something goes wrong for a client, delivery hears about it first and is expected to lead the debugging. We are looking for a leader who has lived in this problem space and knows what it takes to run a delivery platform that clients trust.

Responsibilities

* Own the product vision and roadmap for the Unified Data Delivery Platform, the new platform being built to deliver all of Gracenote's Video data to clients and partners
* Own the portfolio of Video metadata delivery solutions that clients rely on today
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of two product managers in India
* Collaborate with clients and partners to understand the business problems of delivering and ingesting TV entertainment data into their backend solutions, and turn that insight into a clear product vision and roadmap
* Travel to the US and Europe a couple of times per year to meet clients and partners face to face, building the direct market understanding that informs the product vision
* Partner with engineering teams, external partners, and internal stakeholders to prioritize and deliver the roadmap
* Work closely with UX and engineering to deliver the configuration and analytics tools that make the platform successful for clients and internal teams
* Serve as the senior product escalation point when delivery issues arise, leading root cause analysis and driving resolution with engineering and client-facing teams
* Work with senior management to identify opportunities and risks, including new products, infrastructure strategy, and quality initiatives
* Closely manage the cloud infrastructure and costs associated with the data platform

 **Qualifications**  

* 12+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning data delivery, distribution, or client integration products
* Experience managing and mentoring product managers
* Experience building and operating high-scale data or distribution systems
* Hands-on experience with XML, JSON, and REST APIs. Actively uses LLMs to write Python scripts and SQL to answer product questions independently
* Experience running structured development processes with distributed engineering teams, from requirements through release
* Willingness to flex working hours for regular overlap with US and European clients and stakeholders
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Skills/Experience

* Bachelor's degree or higher. Computer Science or Engineering major is preferable
* Experience in OTT, TV broadcast, or supporting customers who develop products for digital content consumption
* Development experience with Gracenote, TMS, ROVI, or other structured entertainment databases

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.
