**Description**
Paylocity is an award-winning provider of cloud-based HR and payroll software solutions, offering the most complete platform for the modern workforce. The company has become one of the fastest-growing HCM software providers worldwide by offering an intuitive, easy-to-use product suite that helps businesses automate and streamline HR and payroll processes, attract and retain talent, and build a strong workplace culture.
  
  
While traditional HR and payroll providers automate basic HR processes such as payroll and benefits administration, Paylocity goes further by developing tools that HR and businesses need to compete for talent and deliver against the expectations of the modern workforce.
  
  
Paylocity acquired Airbase! Airbase Inc., a modern finance and spend management software solution that combines bill pay / accounts payable automation, expense management, corporate cards and procurement capabilities. The acquisition of Airbase represents an expansion of Paylocity’s suite and is expected to deliver incremental integrated value to HR and finance leaders in managing all of their spend on a single platform – expanding the Paylocity total addressable market beyond HCM and further into the Office of the CFO.
  
  
We give our employees what they need to succeed, including great benefits and perks! We offer various benefits, as well as perks that support you, your family, and your finances. And if it’s career development you desire, we provide that, too! At
**Airbase by Paylocity**
, people matter most and have always been at the heart of our business.
  
  
Help
**Airbase by Paylocity**
enhance communication and enable employees to connect, collaborate, and create from anywhere with a position in Product & Technology! Want to develop the strategies and principles needed to deliver compelling software? Join our team and help us enhance our all-in-one software platform, elevate our one-of-a-kind technology, and improve the employee experience. Take your career to the next level at one of G2's Top 100 Software Companies. Explore our Product & Technology positions to see where you fit!
  
  
**Position Overview**
Product management is the function that guides every step of a product’s lifecycle — by focusing on the product and its customers first and foremost. Product Managers identify the most valuable problems to solve, enable their team to ship and iterate high-quality solutions quickly, and validate market impact. They leverage customer insights to deeply understand their problems, define the correct backlog priorities and create a clear Product brief. This is a central role on a cross-functional product team, owning the discovery, definition, and delivery of product solutions that drive measurable customer and business value. This role works independently to lead feature discovery, evaluate tradeoffs, and drive product initiatives from concept to launch—ensuring product utilization leads to tangible customer outcomes and business impact. This role requires strong business acumen and the ability to connect product utilization and adoption to meaningful customer and organizational outcomes. Success in this role requires deep domain expertise and technical feasibility, along with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive results.
  
  
You’ll be joining the Corporate Cards product team within Paylocity for Finance. As a PM II on this team, you’ll own experiences at the center of how companies spend money, from issuing a card to closing the books. Companies can issue Paylocity cards to their employees or connect the corporate cards they already use. Whichever they choose, we provide the spend controls, receipt management, and seamless accounting sync that make life easier for both employees and finance teams. This is a key growth lever for Paylocity’s finance business, and we’re building a differentiated offering in partnership with Visa, Mastercard, and Amex.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
The below represents the primary duties of the position, others may be assigned as needed. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  

* Lead the development and execution of the product roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals, customer outcomes, and security standards
* Prioritize features based on their value to customers, compliance with internal standards, and alignment with product strategy
* Make informed tradeoff decisions to balance customer value, technical feasibility, and security or compliance requirements
* Act as a dedicated customer advocate, proactively gathering and synthesizing feedback to shape product direction
* Establish regular feedback loops with internal and external customers to ensure product solutions evolve alongside user needs
* Collaborate with stakeholders—including Engineering, Design, Marketing, and external partners—to ensure effective execution, transparency, and alignment
* Leverage data and performance metrics to drive prioritization, assess product health, and inform strategy
* Continuously evaluate product and roadmap performance, adjusting direction as needed to stay aligned with customer and market needs

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
  
  
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
  
  
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
  
  
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
  
  
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
  
  
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
  
  
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
  
  
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
  
  
**What We Need**

* Data-native PM — you think in funnels, cohorts, and experiments before PRDs. You write SQL, build dashboards, and catch insights nobody asked you to find.

* Entrepreneur DNA — you've tried building something of your own (a startup, a side project, a 0→1 product) or you're a seasoned Growth PM who's operated across the full acquisition-to-revenue loop.
* Business-grade judgment — you hold your own in revenue conversations, understand unit economics, and translate growth levers into P&L impact.

**This is not a feature PM role.**
There's no stable roadmap someone hands you. You define problems, find levers, ship fast, and measure what matters.
  
  
**What You'll Do -**

* Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights - both qualitative and quantitative.
* Devise Strategy: Define both long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.
* Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data-driven, and test & iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long-term view. Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.
* Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.
* Launch products: Draft and execute a go-to-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.
* Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to collaborate closely with ecosystem players to co-build products that don’t exist

**Mandatory Qualifications**

* You are obsessed with users but grounded in business and data.
* You have 6+ years of experience in product management with at least 2 years focused on growth or PLG initiatives.

* You have a strong command over product analytics and experimentation frameworks.

**Description**
Join Amazon Health Services' One Medical team and shape the systems that determine how customer generated health data and third party health data drive better health outcomes for patients. You will define product strategy and drive execution for the platforms that ingest, normalize, and surface health data from diverse sources — wearables, connected devices, lab integrations, and patient reported inputs — turning fragmented signals into actionable clinical and consumer insights. These systems power experiences across the care continuum: enabling providers to make more informed decisions, helping patients engage meaningfully with their own health, and unlocking data driven personalization across Amazon Health Services.
  
  
Health data is unlike typical consumer data: it is governed by HIPAA and evolving state level privacy regulations, arrives in inconsistent formats (HL7, FHIR, proprietary device APIs), carries clinical significance that demands accuracy, and requires careful consent and access controls. Every product decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how One Medical ingests, reconciles, and leverages customer generated and third party health data to improve care delivery and patient outcomes. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across data ingestion pipelines, health record enrichment, data quality and normalization, and surfacing insights to clinicians and patients — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying data platforms and ML systems.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Define the product vision and multi year roadmap for customer generated health data systems: data ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and clinical surfacing
  
  
Translate complex health data and regulatory constraints (HIPAA, FHIR/HL7 interoperability, consent management, state privacy laws) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against
  
  
Design and own the end to end metrics framework for data quality, completeness, and clinical utility within your domain
  
  
Work with Clinical Operations, Provider Experience, Compliance, Privacy, and Platform Engineering partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
  
  
Partner with Applied Scientists and Engineers to define success criteria for data reconciliation models, insight generation algorithms, and automated triage systems
  
  
Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare
* Experience with ML/AI product management — defining success criteria for models, managing model lifecycle, A/B testing ML systems
* Master's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics

Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.

**Job Title** : Director, Systems Architecture and Modernization

**Reporting to** : Chief Business Transformation Officer

**Location** : Bangalore, India

**Department** : Enterprise Transformation Engine

  

**The Mandate**
===============

Quickbase's Core systems weren't built for what comes next. Every AI workflow, every agentic capability, every attempt to let people outside ETE build against our data runs into the same wall: systems that are tightly coupled, hard to decouple, and carrying years of technical debt.

This role exists to tear that wall down. You will lead the people who build and maintain Core Architecture and Systems Engineering, reduce the debt in systems like Salesforce, and make headless real at Quickbase — our systems exposing clean APIs instead of forcing every integration through custom logic. That is the precondition for everything else ETE is building, including the Builder platform that will let the business build AI workflows without waiting on ETE.

**Builder Platform — Precondition, Not Ownership**

* You do not own the semantic layer, the skills repository, or the AI orchestration infrastructure. That work sits elsewhere, full stop.

* Your job is making Core systems safe and ready to be reached — not defining what Builder does with them

**What's Next**

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Auric AI**

Auric AI is developing the world's most advanced AI-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications

Defense and military organizations today receive overwhelming volumes of visual data from satellites and drones. Processing this manually is slow, expensive, and error-prone. Our mission is to use AI-powered vision systems to detect and classify high-value military objects such as tanks, artillery, radars, and missile launchers so analysts and commanders can act faster and with greater confidence.

We’re a fast-moving defense technology startup, combining world-class AI research with real-world military applications to create intelligence platforms that can make a difference where time and trust matter most.

**The Role**

We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead the development of our Vision Intelligence Platform.

This is not a traditional PM role. You will:

* Think from first principles to design workflows that make AI useful in mission-critical contexts.
* Translate AI research into usable, analyst-facing products.
* Balance speed, trust, and usability when making product decisions.
* Be AI-native using the latest AI tools to build wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and demo flows at speed.
* You will own the end-to-end product experience: defining workflows, designing intuitive screens, prioritizing features, and ensuring analysts receive intelligence they can trust all within minutes of image arrival.

**What You’ll Do**

* Vision & Roadmap

1. Define the product vision and articulate a clear north star for the platform.
2. Build and communicate a roadmap balancing near-term MVP delivery with long-term platform growth.

* Workflow & UX Design

1. Map the full analyst journey: image ingestion → preprocessing → AI detection → quality review → database → dissemination.
2. Work with engineers and designers to create intuitive, analyst-ready screens.
3. Use AI-powered tools (e.g., Figma plugins, AI prototyping, AI design assistants) to generate wireframes and demo flows rapidly.

* Feature Prioritization

1. Define MVP scope and ruthlessly separate must-haves from nice-to-haves.
2. Make trade-offs between speed-to-decision, detection accuracy, and user trust.

* Execution & Delivery

1. Translate requirements into clear PRDs and product specs.
2. Drive collaboration between AI researchers, engineers, and domain experts.
3. Ensure reliability and quality in product releases.

* User & Stakeholder Engagement

1. Engage with analysts, retired officers, and other stakeholders to understand workflows.
2. Synthesize fragmented feedback into coherent product direction.

* Metrics & Success

1. Define and track success metrics: time-to-insight, adoption, accuracy, and trust in outputs.
2. Use feedback and data to iterate rapidly.

**What We’re Looking For**

* AI-native builder: highly proficient in using AI tools for prototyping, wireframing, and creating demo flows.
* First principles thinker who simplifies complex problems into clear workflows.
* Technical fluency: understand how AI and software systems work, even if you don’t code daily.
* User empathy: can design for non-technical users working under pressure.
* Execution strength: bias for rapid prototyping, iteration, and delivery.
* Communication skills: able to align researchers, engineers, and defense users.
* Prior startup/founder experience or exposure to AI/ML products is a strong plus.

**Why Join Us**

* Work on one of the hardest, most impactful problems in defense AI.
* Collaborate with a small, world-class team of researchers and engineers.
* High ownership from day one shapes the platform, not just maintains it.
* Move fast, learn fast, we build, test, and iterate aggressively.
* Be part of a mission-driven company where AI meets national security.

Auric AI is building the future of defense intelligence. If you’re an AI-native product builder who thrives in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Advanced Business Analyst I - SAP WM
jobs.description:
**Department :**
Warehouse Management Solutions
  
  
**Company:**
Novo Nordisk Global Business Services (GBS)
  
  
Bengaluru, India
  
  
JL:6
  
  
Your impact begins here
  
  
As SAP Warehouse Management Advance Business Analyst, you will keep the warehouse systems Novo relies on running smoothly, around the clock and around the world. You will design improvements, resolve issues and shape new warehouse capabilities, including how AI can strengthen them. Thousands of colleagues use these systems every day to run manufacturing, supply and sales, so your expertise helps keep the supply chain moving for people living with serious chronic diseases.
  
  
What you’ll bring
  
  
You are an experienced SAP specialist who works confidently on your own and enjoys turning business needs into reliable warehouse processes.
  
  

* A degree such as BE, BTech, MBA, MCA, MSc or MCom, or equivalent.
* 7+ years of overall experience, including 7+ years in SAP Warehouse Management (WM) and Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) rollout and support projects, with expert-level knowledge of Handling Unit (HU) management and Material Flow System (MFS).
* Solid experience in warehousing processes, including implementing new warehouse capabilities and designing them from business requirements.
* Experience in GxP-regulated environments, including configuration management, and test coordination and validation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work with business users, external parties and ABAP developers.
* The flexibility to work under time pressure and to take part in an on-call rotation for 24x7 incident support.

**Useful, But Not Essential**

* Experience from the pharmaceutical industry.
* Curiosity and agility in applying AI to warehouse processes.
* Experience mentoring or coaching colleagues in your area of expertise.

What you’ll do
  
  
You will be responsible for the logistics part of Novo’s corporate SAP Warehouse Management landscape, covering maintenance and support planning across multiple company codes and countries. You will set direction and deliver results across functions and countries.
  
  

* Design and improve warehouse processes in SAP WM and EWM, based on clear business requirements.
* Lead the implementation of new warehouse capabilities and contribute to WM and EWM projects.
* Support day-to-day system operations and maintenance, and handle incident and problem management on a 24x7 on-call rotation.
* Manage configuration, coordinate testing and validation, and keep systems compliant in a GxP setting.
* Work with ABAP developers to find bugs and shape new developments, prioritising and delivering with ownership.
* Mentor colleagues, share knowledge and explore where AI can strengthen warehouse operations.

Who you’ll work with
  
  
You will join Warehouse Management Solutions within Supply Chain, part of Enterprise IT. In Enterprise IT, colleagues work across the Novo value chain, staying close to stakeholders and helping deliver trusted technology, high quality and responsible ways of working. The team operates, maintains, supports and develops the warehouse systems used globally, from R&D to Sales, and aims to be the IT partner that supports Novo’s production and supply chain needs worldwide.
  
  
Your closest partners will be business users, ABAP developers, external parties and your colleagues in the team. You will represent Novo in conversations with business users and external stakeholders, speak up when things stall and bring people together around clear priorities so that work keeps moving.
  
  
What you can expect here
  
  
You will work independently, with the trust to own your priorities and the support of colleagues who share their knowledge. As Novo expands its digital capabilities, you will have opportunities to deepen your expertise, mentor others and build new skills, including in AI, through hands-on work and relevant learning offerings. You will be expected to perform at a high level, give and receive honest feedback, and make your voice heard in the decisions that shape the systems you work on.
  
  
Start now
  
  
Your impact begins today. If you are ready to keep global warehouse operations running and shape what comes next, apply for the SAP Warehouse Management Advance Business Analyst role by 23 Nov 2026.
  
  
We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Analytics, Engineering or Business Intelligence Post Graduate in Finance/ Business Analytics will be an added advantage Experience working with multiple stakeholders across locations.

Understanding of relational databases – Teradata, IBM DB2, Hadoop, Google Cloud Platform
  
  
Expertise in SQL – DDL & DML – Joins, Partition, Update, Stored Procedures, Query tuning, etc.

Experience with Business Intelligence and Reporting tools, preferably in Power BI Ability to create charts/visualization that aptly represents the trends and analysis
